reviewNotes: AI editorial assessment of 32 original low-typing recognition questions from 16 verb seeds. Per question: solved without relying on the suggested key, evaluated every offered distractor, morphology/infinitival grammar, explicit task cues, alternate readings, bilingual hint and explanation, linkages, completed-answer naturalness, CEFR source label and two distinct usage situations. Four source records deferred because inherited glosses/examples or objective mapping conflict. Publication remains unapproved; no human endorsement, licensing certification or measured learning transfer. Repository structural validation assigned to branch CI, not claimed locally. Final grammar pass after GitHub save caught and corrected the abgelten modal/passive error and the missing zu requirement with abgewöhnen; amended completed answers and reviewed all choices. Earlier saved commit remains in Git history. New SHA computed after corrected catalog.
